recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-7224 as historically applied and now superseded; do not change current core source back to MedicationOrder.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Pharmacy request to rename MedicationPrescription to MedicationOrder and add wording that the name generalized the resource across inpatient, outpatient, and care-plan settings.
initial_application: Commit 9d6493a912e7bc97c41defcda29847eb87f56e9c explicitly cited #7224 and #5896 and mechanically renamed MedicationPrescription to MedicationOrder in source/fhir.ini and medication source files.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-10456 approved renaming MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest for workflow alignment and broader request semantics. Current source has MedicationRequest as the active resource, maps MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest, and explains that MedicationRequest is used rather than MedicationPrescription or MedicationOrder. The closely related FHIR-7229 audit already exists on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit. Current source already preserves the generalized-use rationale through MedicationRequest, and changing it back to MedicationOrder would contradict the later final FHIR-10456 decision.
